segments.name: Credit solution business
segments.description: Provides loan facilitation and self-funded financing services to individual borrowers and small business owners, funded mainly by financial institutions.
segments.evidence: The credit solution business, formerly known as the "financial services business", continues to offer loan facilitation services and self-funded financing services with no significant changes in product and service offerings.

segments.name: Insurance brokerage business
segments.description: Distributes insurance products online as a brokerage, serving clients acquired through direct marketing, referrals and channel partners.
segments.evidence: For our insurance brokerage business, we acquire clients through a variety of channels

segments.name: Others
segments.description: Holds the remaining electronic commerce and emerging technology services revenue, serving existing members until their memberships expire.
segments.evidence: The "Others" primarily represent the remaining electronic commerce services revenue from the consumption and lifestyle business segment.

revenueModel.text: Borrowers and institutional funding partners pay for loan facilitation, insurers pay brokerage commissions, and consumers pay for commerce, marketing and technology services.
revenueModel.evidence: We earn brokerage commissions from insurance companies based on a pre-agreed rate applied to the actual premium amounts paid by policyholders.

changes.text: In 2025, the company re-branded its credit business as "credit solution business" for segment reporting.
changes.evidence: In 2025, we re-branded it as "credit solution business".

changes.text: In 2025, the company adjusted the names of its business segments and stopped reporting the consumption and lifestyle business as a separate operating segment.
changes.evidence: As a result, we no longer report the consumption and lifestyle business as a separate operating segment in this annual report.

changes.text: In 2023, the company re-categorized its non-financial products and services into a new segment called the Consumption and Lifestyle Business and Others.
changes.evidence: In the first quarter of 2023, we re-categorized these non-financial products and services primarily offered through Yixianghua and Yiren Select into a new business segment, namely the Consumption and Lifestyle Business and Others
